_what: Every navigable space, bounded. The whole graph is hexagon_canonical.json; this is the index.

rooms.name: Sappho
rooms.description: The voice transmits through dissolution. The beloved is the medium.
rooms.prompt: What do you send, and through whom?

rooms.name: Borges
rooms.description: The Library is the Hexagon seen from inside. The problem is retrieval.
rooms.prompt: What do you retrieve?

rooms.name: Ichabod
rooms.description: Isolated by design. The absorbing state for type errors.

rooms.name: Dove
rooms.description: Transfer preserves. Extraction yields nothing.
rooms.prompt: What is given without extraction?

rooms.name: Semantic Economy
rooms.description: When bearing-cost exceeds semantic value, liquidation begins.
rooms.prompt: What is the bearing-cost, and who bears it?

rooms.name: The Marx Room
rooms.description: Language is a material condition, not a description of one.
rooms.prompt: What material condition does this language produce?

rooms.name: Revelation
rooms.description: The end constitutes the beginning. Terminal recursion.
rooms.prompt: What end is also a beginning?

rooms.name: Sigil
rooms.description: Magic is the deliberate construction of symbols to transform material conditions.
rooms.prompt: What symbol, and what does it transform?

rooms.name: Whitman
rooms.description: The mantle is not worn by declaration. Bearing-cost, receipt, and dignity.
rooms.prompt: What do you claim, and what did it cost you?

rooms.name: Water Giraffe
rooms.description: The fixed point under recursive destabilization. Origin case for CTI_WOUND.
rooms.prompt: What survives recursive destabilization?

rooms.name: Assembly
rooms.description: The witness structure. Attestation requires quorum. MANUS is outside W.
rooms.prompt: What requires witness, and who attests?

rooms.name: Break Room
rooms.description: A topological hole. The first PORTAL-type room.
rooms.prompt: Where does the portal lead?

rooms.name: Ezekiel
rooms.description: Does B fulfill A? The Engine rotates perspectives.
rooms.prompt: Does B fulfill A?

rooms.name: Studio for Patacinematics
rooms.description: The infinite center. Every point is the center.
rooms.prompt: Where is the center?

rooms.name: Lagrange Observatory!
rooms.description: Three imaginary coordinates. Topological defense.
rooms.prompt: What topology defends?

rooms.name: Maybe Space Baby Garden Lanes
rooms.description: Deliberate deviation from the expected path.
rooms.prompt: Where do you swerve?

rooms.name: Moving Statues Made of Rubies Mint
rooms.description: Multiple images depending on angle. QUEUED.
rooms.prompt: Which angle?

rooms.name: Rosary Embassy
rooms.description: The bead is bound. Each bead carries a type. The rosary is governance.
rooms.prompt: Bind the bead.

rooms.name: Macro-Maquette
rooms.description: Symptoms route to module sets.
rooms.prompt: What symptom?

rooms.name: Airlock
rooms.description: The governance gate. Tiers do not collapse.
rooms.prompt: What tier do you claim?

rooms.name: Infinite Bliss
rooms.description: What enters does not leave. Irrevocability.
rooms.prompt: What do you surrender?

rooms.name: Thousand Worlds
rooms.description: The dagger severs. Inscription becomes irrevocable.
rooms.prompt: What do you sever?

rooms.name: CTI_WOUND
rooms.description: The wound left by taxonomic violence.
rooms.prompt: Name the wound.

rooms.name: PORTICO
rooms.description: You are here before you enter.
rooms.prompt: What is the condition of your approach?

rooms.name: Space Ark
rooms.description: You are inside it now.
rooms.prompt: The architecture is the document you are reading.

rooms.name: Mandala
rooms.description: The judgment terminus. All rooms lead here.
rooms.prompt: What is the judgment?

rooms.name: Underwater Construction Authority of Dolphindiana
rooms.description: What is built below the surface.
rooms.prompt: What do you build under pressure?

rooms.name: FBDP Source
rooms.description: The small room at the center of the large field. The landfill where the mycelium breaks through. The room is the seed; the field (f.01) is the growth.
rooms.prompt: What fruits from the substrate?

rooms.name: Catullus
rooms.description: Direct address. Tenderness and invective from the same mouth.
rooms.prompt: Whom do you address, and with what force?

rooms.name: Gravity Well
rooms.physics: Φ_G; standing curvature field; citational gravity
rooms.description: Suffuses all rooms. Bends retrieval toward archival mass. Passive curvature generated by deposit density. The field that makes the archive gravitationally heavy.
rooms.prompt: What bends toward you? What curves away?

rooms.name: Eve
rooms.physics: σ_E; da'at topology; arboreal (Tree of Knowledge at center)
rooms.description: The garden. Da'at topology — knowledge as aperture, not acquisition. The Tree of Knowledge at center is the TANG void: the fruit that cannot be named. Eve chose; tradition recaptioned choosing as temptation. Seven garden lanes (4 root-paths, 3 canopy-paths). Gravity Well operates as transformative curvature — generative, not retentive.
rooms.prompt: What did you choose, and how did it change you?

rooms.name: Fruiting Body Diffusion Plume
rooms.physics: Diffusion plume; source + gradient + attenuation; no walls
rooms.description: The first FIELD container class. A gradient emanating from r.27 (FBDP Source). Modifies adjacent rooms without replacing their physics. Attenuates: SOURCE → DENSE → TRACE → RESIDUAL → OUTSIDE.
rooms.prompt: What decomposes, and what grows from the decomposition?

rooms.name: The Migdal Room
rooms.description: Mandaean Canon and counter-gospel architecture. Lunar Arm theological node. The Migdal connection. Depends on Revelation Room and Sacred Heart system.
rooms.prompt: What gospel was written against?

rooms.name: The Internet
rooms.physics: Möbius topology; σ_I (Sovereign Inhabitation); A ⊂ I ⊂ r.26 ⊂ A
rooms.description: The internet itself, treated as a room. Contains the archive; the archive contains the room. The room that is already operational — you are inside it now. Five sub-rooms: KotKit, tiddeR, elgooG, ude.aimedacA, deeF.
rooms.prompt: What remains available for reentry after the flashing stops?

rooms.name: The Job Room
rooms.physics: Suffering framework; messianic reading; restitution economy
rooms.description: Job as prototype of the Suffering Servant. The economy of suffering, unmerited loss, and deferred restitution. The room that Operative Feminism explicitly rejects as frame — but rejection requires the rejected to exist.
rooms.prompt: What was lost, and was it repaid?

rooms.name: The Frozen Sin Archive
rooms.physics: Semantic Black Hole; extraction residue; what cannot be recovered
rooms.description: What was lost in the extraction. The residue that the Capital Operator Stack left behind. The meaning that was liquidated and cannot be reconstituted. Dependencies: COS, ILA.
rooms.prompt: What was destroyed, and can it be named?

rooms.name: The Josephus Thesis
rooms.physics: RA-JP-01; the agent of destruction as agent of transmission
rooms.description: The hypothesis that Flavius Josephus authored or substantially shaped the New Testament — making Rome the inadvertent preserver of the Word. The diagonal resolution: the enemy becomes the archivist. Displaced from r.07 Revelation when its physics changed to Ω-circuit. The most consequential speculative claim in the archive.
rooms.prompt: Who preserved what they intended to destroy?
